## CI red on a40a7445 · runner timeout, re-run by a main merge

- `Test UI` (aggregate) is red because shard 2/16 (job 133881208836) hit the 30-minute job limit ("The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s") and was cancelled before its summary.
- The one `×` in that shard's log is `ResourceEditPage.heldBadName-27865.test.tsx` (b), which ran 8805 ms against its own 8000 ms `findBy`/`waitFor` budget. That is the metadata-admin edit page; this PR touches neither it nor its form path's behaviour in jsdom (the new tab-strip effect returns early when `scrollWidth <= clientWidth`, which is always true in jsdom).
- Every other check on a40a7445 passed. The relay `rerun-failed` does not take a cancelled shard, so `origin/main` was merged in by relay `pr_update_branch` (run 44040796658, clean merge commit 49b15fe9), which re-runs every workflow. If (b) reds again on the new head I will reproduce it locally before saying more.

## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T08:06Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 49b15fe90694bfe7f26267d81328dc65e7c6250d
Card: #34615 · claim 6939332200 · os-dev-report 6941285145 (head a40a7445) · CI note 6941957261

Both card items are built inside the claim's surface. Every new class is phone-gated, and a list with no currency column is unchanged. The head is a clean main merge over the reported a40a7445. No must-fix and no should-fix.

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34615`, with no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. |
| Scope | 6 files: `ObjectGrid.tsx` (+33/−7), `form.tsx` (+33/−1), the new `phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx`, a new describe in the shared `form-field-tabs.test.tsx` harness, a repointed `mobileCardFieldCurrency-10423.test.tsx`, and the changeset. All are inside claim 6939332200 (`plugin-grid/src/**`, `components/src/renderers/form/**`, `.changeset/`). `tabs.tsx` is not touched: `TabsList` already forwards its ref. |
| Merge head | `49b15fe9` has parents `a40a7445` and main `b1da9f55` (which carries #34642's section nav in `form.tsx`). `git show --remerge-diff 49b15fe9` is empty, so there is no hand resolution. `form.tsx` on this head carries both #34642's `FormSectionNavContext` and this PR's `fieldTabListRef`. `git diff origin/main...49b15fe9` is the same 6 files, +388/−13. |
| (1) Tab strip classes | The horizontal arm adds `max-sm:max-w-full max-sm:justify-start max-sm:overflow-x-auto max-sm:overflow-y-hidden` and the hidden-scrollbar pair, all `max-sm:`. The vertical arm is unchanged. A pin asserts there is no ungated `overflow-*` / `max-w-*` token. From `sm` up the classes do not apply, so desktop is unchanged (measured: 523.8px, `overflow-x: visible` on both trees at 1280). |
| (2) Active-tab effect | Keyed on `activeFieldTab`. It returns when `scrollWidth <= clientWidth`, so every fitting strip, every desktop strip and jsdom is untouched. It moves only `list.scrollLeft` by the trigger's overhang, never `scrollIntoView` and never an outer scroller. It covers a tap, `defaultFieldTab` and the failed-submit jump, and each is pinned against a stubbed 343px strip. A "strip that fits is never scrolled" control is included. The scroll route is one of the two the card offers (要做的 2), and it adds no i18n key. |
| (3) Phone card amount | `amountCol` is the first body column, not the status column, with `c.type === 'currency'` and not masked. It is drawn through the column's own desktop cell (`cardCell`), so objectui#10423's currency rules hold, and the repointed 10423 file still asserts them at `grid-card-amount`. Classes: `ml-auto shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums`, so the amount is never truncated. The status chip moves to that line's left (`min-w-0 truncate`), and the subtitle takes the next column. With no currency column, `statusOnAmountLine` is false and the #28484 row (chip at the right, `max-w-[45%]`) is drawn as before. `phoneCardRow-28484` passes unedited. |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in the claim, PR body and changeset. No export, no key and no locale string. `data-testid="form-tab-strip"` and the card test ids are DOM hooks, not API. |
| Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/components`, the two published packages whose `src` moved. Both bullets match the code, including "A list with no currency column draws its cards as before" and "Desktop strips and vertical strips are unchanged". |
| Tests | Real commands with output: 768 files / 7095 tests under the lock, plus type-check for both packages. Three ablations: `amountCol` → `false` gives 10 red; the effect's `trigger` → `null` gives 3 red; the class line → `''` gives 1 red. Each is restored with `git diff HEAD` empty. 39/39 derived gates. |
| UI strings | None added. |
| Docs | Searched `content/docs`, `skills`, `packages/spec/src` and the plugin-grid README for the phone card layout and the field-tab strip's overflow. None describes them, so nothing is made false. |
| Acceptance | 1: `CN¥1,200,000.00` whole at 375 (121.6px box of 122px, was clipped at 75.2 of 104). 2: page overflow 0 (was 165px), the strip is 343px with `scrollWidth 524 > clientWidth 343`, and the 5th tab and its error dot are visible after the scroll. Both were measured on the components' real DOM with compiled Tailwind in Chromium. The live Console with CRM metadata is declared NOT MEASURED. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34695`: NOT governed, 401 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-C. |
| CI on this head | 58 check-runs, all `success` or `skipped`, none pending: Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check. The earlier shard 2/16 red on a40a7445 was the 30-minute job limit (6941957261). It is green here. |

### Notes

1. **No e2e geometry pin.** The 375px readings were taken once, and the jsdom pins hold the class contract and the scroll arithmetic. A `ui/e2e` Playwright pin for both readings would make them re-derivable in CI. That is outside this surface; the report records it as a carrier-less note.
2. **Stale comment** above `isMaskedCardColumn`: it still mentions field-name branches for amount and stage that no longer exist (report out-of-scope finding 2). It costs nothing to fix next time the file is touched.
3. **Signature line** (point 4 of the request): the plain-text `signed:` line is not an L1 bar. The os-dev.md / standard-order mismatch is the seat's to reconcile. No patch is needed for this verdict.
